reference_lifecycle.blank_comparison: exact raw text equality to empty string; no trim
reference_lifecycle.veto_parent: the still-open DialogEdit input, not TagPresentationPanel
reference_lifecycle.veto_buttons: QMessageBox.warning default sole OK; existing same-call warning recorder records OK. Specific real blank-entry button/lifecycle capture still needed.
reference_lifecycle.veto_effect: No accepted dialog result, no namespace handler invocation and no draft mutation; synchronous nested warning returns, validation False leaves input modal/open with same blank text.
reference_lifecycle.ack_effect: Dismiss only nested Warning; same input remains, original handler slot remains pending.
reference_lifecycle.whitespace_effect: Raw whitespace is nonempty, accepted by text widget, then namespace handler lower/strip rejects reserved/default namespace after input closes. Handler warning is parented to TagPresentationPanel, unlike blank veto.
reference_lifecycle.return_scope: Source explicitly wires Apply and DoOK into same Accepted validation; other key events delegate to inherited Qt QDialog behavior. Physical Return/default-button routing is not recorded in current fixture; capture it with actual Qt key dispatch rather than infer from handler mocks.
reference_lifecycle.cancel_scope: Input Cancel/Escape takes Rejected; skips acceptance validation and EnterText raises cancellation caught by namespace handler. Warning OK dismisses nested warning only. Qt input/warning are QObject-owned modal children. Options Cancel is not a normal physical click while nested modal active; native owner retirement is an additional safety boundary.

caveats: Source-guidance only; no real Qt recorder executed, no native build/test/render performed and no approvals added.
Existing real namespace recorder intentionally bypasses blank text-widget validation; its scripted empty handler case remains valid within that documented handler scope.
Parent cancellation/owner retirement needs meaningful new native regression for nested blank notice; current Add/warning tests do not automatically cover a newly added nested owner.

Qt messagebox icon/window decoration and native headless buffers differ; no exact-pixel/full-dialog parity claim. Namespace Edit/picker lifecycle and broader TagPresentation parent remain out of scope.
